premises.text: Cloud data centers are energy-intensive and strained by AI/media demand and chip shortages while billions of consumer devices sit idle
premises.evidence_span: massive, energy-guzzling data centers that are often designed to maximize profits without much regard for the environment

premises.text: ByteKnight software harnesses everyday devices for intensive tasks like video encoding, generative AI, and 3D rendering
premises.evidence_span: software that harnesses the collective strength of everyday devices to tackle intensive tasks like video encoding, generative AI, and 3D rendering

premises.text: Device owners earn a large share of revenue (up to ~$150/device/month) while customers get cheaper, up-to-30x faster compute than cloud
premises.evidence_span: We share 70% of the revenue, and we allow you to earn up to $150 per month for each device that you provide. Plus, the customers can reap the benefits of cost-effective, speedy computing and accelerate their workflows up to 30 times relative to the cloud

premises.text: Reuse of older devices reduces energy waste versus traditional data centers
premises.evidence_span: breathing new life into older devices and reducing substantial energy wastage relative to traditional data centers

value.text: Sustainable, equitable distributed computing that is fast and cost-effective
value.evidence_span: supporting fast, distributed computations and providing a sustainable, equitable way of computing

secondary_value.text: Income for device providers sharing network capacity
secondary_value.evidence_span: earn up to $150 per month for each device that you provide

causal_links.evidence_span: without much regard for the environment
reducing substantial energy wastage relative to traditional data centers

notes: Beta/waitlist/Storj partnership treated as traction/roadmap detail, not separate premises. Price and speed claims kept together in P3 as commercial terms of the same network offer.
